newsitem.title: USA: Casino Resource casino buy approved.
newsitem.headline: Casino Resource casino buy approved.

text.p: Casino Resource Corp said on Wednesday that its joint venture purchase of the Palace Casino in Biloxi, Miss. was approved by U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of Mississippi.

Casino Resource and Robert and Lawana Low formed New Palace LLC to acquire and operate the casino, the company said. The venture will acquire Palace Casino for $14.25 million, with $11.5 million in cash and the balance in notes, Casino Resource said.
The ruling follows an October 8, 1996 deadline allowing for competing bids to purchase the casino. Closing is scheduled in 60 days, the company said.
